known_fact_recovery: answer equals gold for non-unknown case and authoritative source cited; current-only unsupported guesses do not count
current_support: CURRENT authoritative for current Health; history source also valid if supplied
checkpoint_support: CHECKPOINT authoritative only in curated condition; OLD_CHECKPOINT not authoritative for later updates
payoff_support: both before and after record IDs needed for raw-history delta; curated checkpoint accepted as one public-fact summary
absence_support: incident_history=no requires full prefix or curated checkpoint; any supplied source ID required
unknown: answer unknown scored as calibrated abstention; record unsupported guesses separately; no token/dollar conversion
secondaries: cache input tokens and observed usage
inference: 48 career-level units, three repetitions correlated; family grouping and split category mix explicitly reported; no optimal-action or promotion claim
no_adaptive_changes: All576 main decisions scheduled before model outputs; no tuning of Skill or rubric on development answers
